Smart Distance is an AR-based distance measurement app that uses your smartphone's camera to measure real-world distances with ease. Powered by Google ARCore technology, the app automatically detects your device's capabilities and selects the optimal measurement engine for the best accuracy.

[Measurement Engine Tiers]

• Premium (ToF/LiDAR): Uses hardware depth sensors for professional-grade accuracy (±2cm)

• High (Depth API): Software-based depth estimation with high precision (±5cm)

• Standard (ARCore): Plane detection and feature tracking (±10cm)

• Basic (Camera): Basic camera-based estimation for devices without AR support

[How to Measure]

1. Tap the Measure button on the main screen

2. Point your camera at the object you want to measure

3. Wait for the tracking to stabilize (move slowly)

4. Align the center target with the object

5. Tap the screen to capture the measurement

[Tips for Accurate Measurement]

• Ensure good lighting conditions

• Move your device slowly during initialization

• Keep a steady hand while measuring

• Measure surfaces with visible features and textures

• Avoid reflective or transparent surfaces

• Optimal distance range is 0.5m to 5m

[Menu Guide]

• History: View, manage, and delete your saved measurements

• Settings: Customize units, theme, sound/vibration feedback, and display options

• Engine Tier: Check your device's measurement capability tier

• About: App information, version, and developer contact

[Settings Options]

• Default Unit: Choose between meters, centimeters, feet, inches, yards, or millimeters

• Auto Save: Automatically save measurements to history

• Sound/Vibration: Enable feedback on measurement capture

• Grid Overlay: Display alignment grid on camera view

• Level Indicators: Show horizontal and vertical level guides

This app allows using your phone as a head tracking device for games on your PC. Works with games which support FreeTrack 2.0 protocol but can also connect directly with Opentrack.

Many flight or racing simulation games support head tracking. HeadTrack on your phone can be your head tracking device, no additional hardware is required. HeadTrack tracks your head movement and rotation which is sent to your games.

The HeadTrack app on your phone supports Gyroscope or Camera as input. The Gyroscope input has very little latency which makes it good for quick movements. The Camera input supports full 6DoF tracking.

Supported Inputs

• HeadTrack (recommended) - Available for Android & iOS with Gyroscope or Camera.

• Opentrack App - Connect any app which is compatible with Opentrack.

• Live Link App - Another alternative iOS app with camera input

Supported Outputs

• FreeTrack (recommended / Windows only) - Head tracking data is sent to games which support FreeTrack 2.0. This should work with most games which support head trackers.

• Opentrack - Head tracking data is sent to Opentrack on this PC. This is useful if you already have Opentrack set up.

• FlightGear - Plugin for FlightGear

• X-Plane - Plugin for X-Plane 9+

Supported Games

Most games which support head tracking should work with HeadTrack. Some games we can confirm are working: Arma 3, BeamNG.drive, FlightGear, X-Plane.

In your game, look into the settings if there is any support for FreeTrack or similar head tracking devices.

If there is any input or output you would like to see added, let us know!
